caption: orange track as a game engine - loops, corkscrews and tv-show stunt contracts.
about: Hot wheels: stunt track challenge (2003) builds its races out of the toy's own grammar: orange track, boosters, loops and corkscrews assembled into a tv stunt show where you earn contracts between events. The stunt-scoring loop and the licensed car roster made it the best hot wheels game of the era - a claim the franchise kept failing to take back for two decades.
The windows build is off sale, carried by archive routes.
